thread:
anya.ops: Heads up — north-3 GPU pool autoscaler lagging, provisioning ETA > 12m, queue backlog +32% vs baseline. Seeing a number of PodPending with PV attach timeout. Escalating to SRE + support. #north3 :rotating_light:
samir.sre: On it. can you paste `kubectl get pods -n inference` and recent cluster-provisioner logs? :eyes:
anya.ops: sure, snippet below:
```
NAME                                 READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE
inference-xxxxx-1                    0/1     Pending   0          6m
inference-xxxxx-2                    0/1     Pending   0          5m
...
Events:
  Normal  Scheduled  6m   default-scheduler  Successfully assigned pod to node but volume attach timed out
  Warning AttachVolume 5m  attach-detacher  AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume ...: timed out after 300s
```
incident-bot: [autoscaler-alert] gpu-n3-a100 scaling stalled: attach-timeout detected across 12 provisioning attempts. See /alerts/AS-1719 for details.
mike.eng: This smells like the provider's AZ rotation that caused attach latencies last month. Can we check node-provisioner logs for `attach-controller` errors?
samir.sre: Good point. Short term mitigation: shift traffic away from north-3 to north-2 (warm pool). Also enable spillover to dedicated-reserve for impacted enterprise tenants. Shift should start within ~3m, rebalance 8–12m. I'll run LB rule change and prewarm nodes.
olivia.support: Drafting a status message: "We are investigating increased inference latency and provisioning delays in the north-3 region. Some customers may experience increased errors or queued requests. We are shifting traffic to an adjacent region and expect mitigation within 15–30 minutes. We will update as we have new information." Thoughts?
anya.ops: Add a line about potential temporary burst charges for customers on pay-as-you-go if we hit dedicated-reserve spillover. Keep ETA conservative: 30m to full recovery.
samir.sre: Applying route change now. command:
```bash
# internal router API
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  https://internal-router/api/v1/route-shift 
  -d '{"from":"north-3","to":"north-2","percent":40}'
```
incident-bot: Route change executed. 28% traffic shifted to north-2; prewarm jobs queued (job-id: prewarm-1719002345). Monitoring metrics.
olivia.support: Posted status update: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/1719002345 and notified affected customers via support queue. Included note about potential billing impact and contact link.
mike.eng: Prewarm started, provisioning additional nodes in north-2 to handle +40% sustained load. command output: `prewarm job 1719002345 -> started (estimating 6m)`
olivia.support: Two enterprise customers requested emergency SLA failover — escalated to CSM + AMs, added to incident notes.
anya.ops: Good. I'll take customer comms for the next 30m and coordinate post-incident RCA owners.
samir.sre: quick metrics update: pending queue growth down to +8% from +32%. Latency for in-flight requests improving. Keeping the shift and prewarm running; will report back in 10m.
anya.ops: Thanks — tagging execs and operations leads. Will update status page if we hit full recovery or need extended ETA.
